summary: Four of six seats returned schema-valid reviews of the close bundle (codex, qwen, kimi, glm), each asking for revision; claude and gemini returned malformed output and contribute no opinion. Two groups have two supporters: the close record's missing gate citations, and the new Markdown reader under the GO4 guard (unread, and wrong on a multi-line code span). Eleven concerns have one supporter each, three of them rated blocking: the page example's orphaned subtype link, an empty round's null counts, and the full lane predating the head.

agreed_concerns.title: The close record must cite the guard, lint and component-index runs
agreed_concerns.summary: The completion predicate names the structure and inventory guards, both ruff runs and the component-index check; close-results.md cites only the focused lane.

agreed_concerns.title: The GO4 guard rests on a new Markdown reader no reviewer had read, and it misreads a multi-line code span
agreed_concerns.summary: tests/support/markdown_sections.py carried comment state across lines but not code-span state, so `<!--` inside a code span that continues onto the next line was read as a comment.
